typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Id as string,
		Retirement_Date__c as string,
		Birthdate as string,
		Effective_Date__c as string,
		CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c as string,
		CMS_FILE_DATE__c as string,
		MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c as string,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c as string,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/caret_date_Contact_update.csv']) ~> caretDateContactSF
source(output(
		Id as string,
		RETIREMENT_DATE__c as string,
		Birthdate__c as string,
		Effective_Date__c as string,
		CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c as string,
		CMS_FILE_DATE__c as string,
		MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c as string,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c as string,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/caret_date_Lead_update.csv']) ~> caretDateLeadSF
source(output(
		Id as string,
		kp_Retirement_Date__c as string,
		kp_Birthdate as string,
		kp_Effective_Date__c as string,
		kp_CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c as string,
		kp_CMS_FILE_DATE__c as string,
		kp_MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c as string,
		kp_Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c as string,
		kp_Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/contact_update_caret_date_Contact.csv']) ~> caretDateContactFile
source(output(
		Id as string,
		kp_RETIREMENT_DATE__c as string,
		kp_Birthdate__c as string,
		kp_Effective_Date__c as string,
		kp_CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c as string,
		kp_CMS_FILE_DATE__c as string,
		kp_MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c as string,
		kp_Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c as string,
		kp_Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/contact_update_caret_date_Lead.csv']) ~> caretDateLeadFile
TrimContactId, caretDateContactFile join(TrimContactId@Id == caretDateContactFile@Id,
	joinType:'inner',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto')~> Join1
TrimLeadId, caretDateLeadFile join(TrimLeadId@Id == caretDateLeadFile@Id,
	joinType:'inner',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto')~> Join2
Join1 derive(Retirement_Date__c = iif(kp_Retirement_Date__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), Retirement_Date__c),
		Birthdate = iif(kp_Birthdate == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), Birthdate),
		Effective_Date__c = iif(kp_Effective_Date__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), Effective_Date__c),
		CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c = iif(kp_CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c),
		CMS_FILE_DATE__c = iif(kp_CMS_FILE_DATE__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), CMS_FILE_DATE__c),
		MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c = iif(kp_MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c),
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c = iif(kp_Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c),
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c = iif(kp_Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c)) ~> DerivedColumn1
Join2 derive(RETIREMENT_DATE__c = iif(kp_RETIREMENT_DATE__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), RETIREMENT_DATE__c),
		Birthdate__c = iif(kp_Birthdate__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), Birthdate__c),
		Effective_Date__c = iif(kp_Effective_Date__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), Effective_Date__c),
		CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c = iif(kp_CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c),
		CMS_FILE_DATE__c = iif(kp_CMS_FILE_DATE__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), CMS_FILE_DATE__c),
		MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c = iif(kp_MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c),
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c = iif(kp_Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c),
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c = iif(kp_Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c == '1900-01-01', toString(null()), Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c)) ~> DerivedColumn2
DerivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		Id = TrimContactId@Id,
		Retirement_Date__c,
		Birthdate,
		Effective_Date__c,
		CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c,
		CMS_FILE_DATE__c,
		MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select3
DerivedColumn2 select(mapColumn(
		Id = TrimLeadId@Id,
		RETIREMENT_DATE__c,
		Birthdate__c,
		Effective_Date__c,
		CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE__c,
		CMS_FILE_DATE__c,
		MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE__c,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Expire_Date__c,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Expiration__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select4
caretDateContactSF derive(Id = left(Id, 15)) ~> TrimContactId
caretDateLeadSF derive(Id = left(Id, 15)) ~> TrimLeadId
Select3 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['update_caret_date_Contact.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> upsertCaretDateContact
Select4 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['update_caret_date_Lead.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> upsertCaretDateLead
